args.summary: The v2.3.1 deployment of checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. In response, all regions were rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback verification confirms the service is healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate back to 0.2%. v2.3.1 requires investigation before any re-deploy is attempted.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1, which was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back** all regions to **v2.3.0** — the rollback completed and was approved/verified.
3. **Verified recovery**: the service is now healthy in all regions on v2.3.0, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident `INC-0001`** (on-call has been paged) documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the verified recovery. Note that v2.3.1 should be investigated before any re-deploy attempt.
